$description: C1XX Foundations · motion. Four durations, three easings, one reduced-motion rule. Values are plain numbers so GSAP, Lenis and CSS can read them the same way. Ambient background animations (the site's 14–17s aurora) are theme-level and not part of the base.

fast.$description: State feedback: hover, press, toggle. Replaces 200–250ms.

base.$description: Default transition: reveal, fade, colour. Replaces 300–350ms (the site's most common value, 17×).

slow.$description: Layout change, sheet open, page element enter. Replaces 450–650ms.

scene.$description: Page-level scene transitions and project covers. Replaces 800–1200ms.

enter.$description: Fast out, long settle. Already shared by both products: the site's main curve (16×) and Syncline's `soft`.

exit.$description: Accelerate out of view. Elements leaving should not linger.

standard.$description: Symmetric-ish for things that move and stay on screen: sliders, tabs, reorder.

base.$description: Delay between siblings in a list reveal. Cap total at duration.slow.

reduced.$description: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every duration becomes duration.reduced and transforms that imply movement (translate, scale) are dropped; opacity transitions stay.

gsap.$description: Same values in GSAP's units (seconds) so the two never drift.
